name: Trump National Doral Miami
positioning: Golf resort in Doral, Miami, with four championship courses including the Blue Monster, villa-like lodges and a large spa
best_for: Golfers who want to play the Blue Monster and three other courses at one resort
Travelers who want golf, spa, tennis and pool time in one place

facts.text: Doral first opened its doors in 1962 and was built with golf at its core.
The resort has four championship golf courses, including the Blue Monster.
Besides the Blue Monster, the courses are the Red Tiger, the Golden Palm and the Silver Fox.
On the Blue Monster, Jack Nicklaus won twice, Greg Norman three times and Tiger Woods four times.
Rooms and suites are designed as intimate villa-like lodges, just steps from the main clubhouse and the golf courses.
Rooms look out over the resort's landscape from a private balcony or terrace.
BLT Prime is a contemporary steakhouse that starts meals with its signature warm popovers.
The Experience Salon is an intimate whiskey and bourbon lounge, with private tastings by appointment only.
There are four Har-Tru tennis courts, all lit for night play.
The fitness center in the clubhouse has views of the resort landscape and the Blue Monster course.
The Trump Golf Academy runs an after-school junior golf program for beginner and intermediate players.

highlights.text: Architect Gil Hanse led a complete redesign of the historic Blue Monster course.
The PGA Tour returns to Trump National Doral from March 3 to 7, 2027.
The Royal Palm Pool has 18 private cabanas and a 125-foot slide.
Sushi by Bou serves a chef-led omakase at a 20-seat counter at the resort.
Guests can stay overnight in The Trump Spa Suites.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes the resort is located away from Miami Beach and downtown attractions.
The spa is at 8755 NW 36th Street and is reached from the Spa Parking Lot within the Pritikin Longevity Center.
The resort is smoke-free, and guests must be 21 or older to check into a room on their own.
